name: Enyo

source.map_area_convention: [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive; original icon-image pixels, x right, y down
source.geometry_convention: Clockwise y-down polygons, not repeated closed vertex; simplified visible roof/main-structure footprints; heights above local ground/platform
source.rotation_convention: Pad rotation_deg: clockwise from +x to first polygon edge, modulo 180; a drawing reference, not a pad class or in-game heading

scale.how: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
scale.basis: User-confirmed classes, user working dimensions Large170x90m, Medium135x70m, Small70x50m.
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

fingerprint.description: A walled military compound with western HAB/MED, southern CMD/SEC/OPR complex, northern STO warehouse wings, PWR and eastern landing area.

buildings.label: HAB
buildings.notes: One connected HAB/MED roof. MED is retained in printed_labels and does not create a second building. Low-confidence two-level massing and height from side view; access/caret symbols do not supply floors.

buildings.label: STO
buildings.notes: Connected northern STO roof and larger southern warehouse wings retained as a single complex; footprint simplifies small wall steps and enclosed courtyard/roof recesses. Side view suggests a tall upper wing above lower warehouse wings; estimate is low confidence.

buildings.label: CMD
buildings.notes: Connected command complex. SEC, CMD and OPR^ are printed room/area labels on this same roof, not independent buildings. Low-confidence height/floors from side view; roof-mounted communications dish is a separate detail.

buildings.label: PWR
buildings.notes: Power machinery envelope and connected east entry wing; taller machinery is included in height envelope but not inferred as an extra occupied floor.
Unlabelled fixed service hut embedded beside western defensive wall; not an unlabelled room split of PWR.
Unlabelled fixed pad-side service hut east of the parked ship; parked craft and shadow excluded.
Unlabelled eastern gate/defence service structure. Editorial tip is nearby and assigned to this neighbouring structure with low confidence.
Only visible lower part of an unlabelled fixed service structure survives beneath top menu. Height/floors cannot be matched reliably to side image; no unseen top reconstructed.
Unlabelled guard/service roof inside north-west wall corner, distinguished from its adjoining wall and tower.

pads.size_source: Explicit user confirmation during settlement-by-settlement review

outline_reconstruction.how: Anchor visible southern boundary at approximately [516,106]..[788,90], extend both side edges north at right angles, and use the agreed working Medium class aspect ratio 135:70 to propose a 525px depth across a 272.47px short edge. Raven photograph validates complete rectangular form and placement; it does not uniquely fix missing top-down corners. Hidden depth is finally inferred from the agreed pad dimension under the independently fitted image transform. It is not a scale control. The earlier Raven/aspect-based proposal is retained separately as uncertain diagnostic evidence.
inferred_geometry: Full reconstructed Medium pad; observed southern boundary is slightly tilted. Most of the pad lies north of the source image, so negative original-image y coordinates are intentional. Far edge is an assumption and must not be presented as a measured trace.

Hidden depth is finally inferred from the agreed pad dimension under the independently fitted image transform. It is not a scale control. The earlier Raven/aspect-based proposal is retained separately as uncertain diagnostic evidence.

pad-north-visible.notes: Full corrected outline is stored, including documented inferred hidden geometry. Source crop remains; original visible fragment is preserved in the pad record.

uncertain: All footprints are approximate original-plan pixels, with clockwise y-down winding and no repeated closing vertex. Roof recesses, marker occlusion, eaves and slight perspective cannot establish exact ground walls.

Historical tracing note, superseded by this revision's scale and verified pad classes: All supplied height_m/floors estimates are LOW confidence and use side-view massing only; no metric scale is inferred. The clipped northern structure cannot be reliably matched, so its height and floors are null.
HAB and MED are labels on one connected western roof; SEC, CMD and OPR^ label one command complex. printed_labels preserves them without inventing physical building splits.
Upper and lower STO wings are treated as one connected storage complex. If interior connectivity matters, this grouping needs in-game verification.
L0/>L0 and door numerals denote security/access, not storeys. Every point.floor is null. Literal carets in 0^,1^,3^,A^ and OPR^ are retained without conversion to a floor.
Northern landing area and northern unlabelled roof are clipped by the top menu at y=40. Their polygons/centres describe visible extents only, not reconstructed complete shapes.

Historical tracing note, superseded by this revision's scale and verified pad classes: Eastern pad footprint follows visible perimeter marks; the parked ship and cast shadow obscure some interior detail and are excluded. Pad rotation is a drawing reference only; no pad size is classified.
Perimeter wall, bastion and gate segmentation follows visible fixed components. Access gaps between wall runs, gate posts and roofs are intentional and are not filled with guessed connectors.
Only two visibly elevated warehouse loading ramps are represented as walkways. General snow/paving between roofs and pads is not a continuous surveyed path; omitted route gaps are intentional.
The blue i is editorial guidance, associated with the nearest eastern gate building only with low confidence. Orange website i, CREDIT badge, menus and legend are excluded from points.

Small ancillary utility/container/fixture functions are inferred conservatively and remain low confidence; detail entries store geometry only while their notes and confidence are separate keyed metadata. Ships, people, vehicles, skimmers, rocks and cast shadows are excluded.
Current pad correction pad-north-visible: low confidence. Hidden or snow-obscured edges are inferred; the correction evidence and original visible polygon are retained.

metric_estimates.scope: One shared pad-based horizontal transform applied to source traces and documented pad reconstructions.

construction.verification: Every live Approximate Shopping List was opened and its commodity IDs/quantities captured. Sorted commodity-pair FNV-1a digest and quantity sum were independently checked against this saved record. Values are approximate, not a guaranteed project bill.

distinctive_geometry_features: The walled compound has a western HAB/MED wing, broad northern STO warehouse and southern CMD/SEC/OPR complex.
A separate rotated PWR module occupies the southwest side of the internal container courtyard.
An external medium pad is beyond STO, north and mostly cropped locally; a small pad stands outside the eastern wall.

pad_correspondence.landing_target_notes: Recorded [653,73.5] is the midpoint of a short visible southern strip, not the medium-pad touchdown point. Most of the pad and its target lie above y=40/outside the image. Corrected target is not directly discernible. Do not calibrate from this midpoint.
No correction proposed; existing coordinate is a schematic image-space centre, not automatically a surveyed touchdown target.

calibration.method: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
calibration.basis: Human-confirmed pad classes and agreed working dimensions
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

Colonisation.metric_height_policy: Prior roof/storey/equipment height estimates are retained, with their original confidence/basis. The revised pad-based registration updates horizontal metres and visible footprint dimensions.

previous_scale.how: Weighted symmetric semantic roof-boundary ICP with independently matched pad target anchors; no physical pad dimensions or renderer rectangle constants used.
previous_scale.basis: Visually matched SrvSurvey telemetry-based metric layout: verified pad classes/positions with roof or physical-feature checks. Physical S/M/L pad deck dimensions are not treated as officially specified.
previous_scale.limitations: Approximate uniform horizontal scale; camera perspective, terrain, roof parallax and cropped/obscured landing targets limit accuracy. Range is a practical judgement, not a statistical confidence interval.

previous_calibration.fit_method: Weighted symmetric semantic roof-boundary ICP with independently matched pad target anchors; no physical pad dimensions or renderer rectangle constants used.

excluded_pad_centres.reason: Recorded [653,73.5] is the midpoint of a short visible southern strip, not the medium-pad touchdown point. Most of the pad and its target lie above y=40/outside the image. Corrected target is not directly discernible. Do not calibrate from this midpoint.

validation_notes: Original local pixel geometry remains unchanged.
Pad targets hidden by a ship or clipped image have reduced evidential precision; recorded image centres are not geodetic surveys.
Roof paths are manually recorded template geometry and local envelopes are simplified; outline residuals measure registration quality, not source metric survey accuracy.
The affine model is diagnostic: a single uniform m_per_px cannot fully remove perspective/terrain distortion.
Artificial menu/legend/image-edge closing segments are excluded from roof samples; projected template points outside the visible map are excluded from registration.
previous_calibration.uncertainty_interval_basis: Conservative visual/template registration allowance; not a statistical confidence interval. Includes approximate roof envelopes, occlusion, possible camera foreshortening and semantic template accuracy.

geometry_m.coordinate_precision_note: Four decimals support reproducible drawing and do not imply millimetre physical accuracy.
geometry_m.height_policy: Original height_m and floor estimates are retained; horizontal calibration does not establish heights.

outline_reconstruction.how: Anchor visible southern boundary at approximately [516,106]..[788,90], extend both side edges north at right angles, and use the agreed working Medium class aspect ratio 135:70 to propose a 525px depth across a 272.47px short edge. Raven photograph validates complete rectangular form and placement; it does not uniquely fix missing top-down corners. Hidden depth is finally inferred from the agreed pad dimension under the independently fitted image transform. It is not a scale control. The earlier Raven/aspect-based proposal is retained separately as uncertain diagnostic evidence.
inferred_geometry: Full reconstructed Medium pad; observed southern boundary is slightly tilted. Most of the pad lies north of the source image, so negative original-image y coordinates are intentional. Far edge is an assumption and must not be presented as a measured trace.

Hidden depth is finally inferred from the agreed pad dimension under the independently fitted image transform. It is not a scale control. The earlier Raven/aspect-based proposal is retained separately as uncertain diagnostic evidence.

Perpendicular segment widths transformed by the full matrix; width_m is the length-weighted mean.

footprint_bounds_m.scope: Traced structures plus documented full-pad reconstructions; other off-image/clipped structures remain incomplete.

geometry_m.superseded_note: Kept for traceability. site_m holds the plan fitted to SrvSurvey's measured positions, in SrvSurvey's site frame.

frame.origin: Settlement position from the journal (ApproachSettlement Latitude/Longitude), as SrvSurvey uses it
frame.heading: Site heading = ship heading while docked on pad 1, or ship heading minus that pad's rotation_deg on any other pad (SrvSurvey HumanSiteData).
frame.to_world: bearing = heading + atan2(x, y); east = x*cos(h) + y*sin(h); north = -x*sin(h) + y*cos(h)
frame.rotation_convention: rotation_deg and rot_deg are clockwise from +y
frame.floor_convention: SrvSurvey floors: 1 = ground floor, 2 = one floor up, 3 = two floors up. SrvSurvey also uses 0: on every combat-zone point and on a few others, where its meaning isn't documented; those are copied as given. floor_basis says where each floor came from: srvsurvey, or icon carets (the plan's ^ marks, no caret = ground floor). plan_floor keeps the plan's reading where SrvSurvey's differs.
frame.access_convention: Security level 0-3: SrvSurvey's level where matched, otherwise the plan's printed number
frame.source_convention: plan = only on the plan; srvsurvey = only in SrvSurvey; plan+srvsurvey = both, at SrvSurvey's position

site_m.pixel_to_site_note: [X, Y, W] = M . [px, py, 1]; site = (X/W, Y/W). Third row is [0, 0, 1] for a uniform fit.
